LEFT JOIN `shop`.`customers` AS `c` ON `s`.`customer_id` = `c`.`id`
GROUP BY date_format(`s`.`day`,'%Y-%m'), (date_format(`s`.`day`,'%Y-%m') IS NULL)
LIMIT 13 OFFSET 0
with_join.sql:
SELECT `c`.`segment` COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin AS `pv_r1`, COUNT(CASE WHEN date_format(`s`.`day`,'%Y-%m') = :p1 THEN 1 END) AS `pv_c1`, COUNT(CASE WHEN date_format(`s`.`day`,'%Y-%m') = :p2 THEN 1 END) AS `pv_c2`, COUNT(CASE WHEN date_format(`s`.`day`,'%Y-%m') IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS `pv_c3`, COUNT(*) AS `pv_total`
FROM `shop`.`sales` AS `s`
LEFT JOIN `shop`.`customers` AS `c` ON `s`.`customer_id` = `c`.`id`
WHERE (date_format(`s`.`day`,'%Y-%m') IN (:p3, :p4) OR date_format(`s`.`day`,'%Y-%m') IS NULL)
GROUP BY `c`.`segment` COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin, (`c`.`segment` COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin IS NULL)
ORDER BY (`c`.`segment` COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin IS NULL), `c`.`segment` COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin ASC
LIMIT 201 OFFSET 0
